# Getting help

Start with the [README](../README.md), [usage guide](../docs/usage.md), [development guide](../docs/development.md), and [known limitations](../known-issues.md).

- Report a reproducible problem through [Bug report](https://github.com/PranavP2207/Desk-Helper/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- Suggest a workflow improvement through [Feature request](https://github.com/PranavP2207/Desk-Helper/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- For setup questions, open an issue explaining your Windows/Node versions, command, and sanitized error message.
- Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for security-sensitive matters.

Use invented examples rather than personal clipboard contents. Support is community-based; no response time is promised.
